blocks.explanation:
Upar squares ka farq hai aur neeche "sin cos" ke products ka farq. Pehli nazar mein mushkil lagta hai, lekin do jaane pehchane aujaar kaafi hain.
Saabit kya karna hai? Fraction \(= \tan(\alpha + \beta)\).
Plan: Upar \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) aur sum-to-product se \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) banayein. Neeche \(\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta\) aur sum-to-product se \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)\). Phir \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) cancel.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin^{2}\alpha - \sin^{2}\beta}{\sin\alpha\cos\alpha - \sin\beta\cos\beta}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan(\alpha + \beta)\).
Tareeqa: Factorise, sum-to-product formulas, aur double-angle formula \(2\sin u\cos u = \sin 2u\).

Numerator: squares ka farq
\[\sin^{2}\alpha - \sin^{2}\beta\]
\[= (\sin\alpha + \sin\beta)(\sin\alpha - \sin\beta)\]
Kyun: Algebra ka formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\), jahan \(a = \sin\alpha\), \(b = \sin\beta\). Is se squares hat gaye aur sines ke jama/farq ban gaye.

Har bracket ko product banayein
\[\sin\alpha + \sin\beta = 2\sin\tfrac{\alpha + \beta}{2}\cos\tfrac{\alpha - \beta}{2}\]
\[\sin\alpha - \sin\beta = 2\cos\tfrac{\alpha + \beta}{2}\sin\tfrac{\alpha - \beta}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sin P + \sin Q\) aur \(\sin P - \sin Q\) wale formulas.

Double angles mein regroup karein
\[\text{Num.} = \left(2\sin\tfrac{\alpha + \beta}{2}\cos\tfrac{\alpha + \beta}{2}\right)\times\]
\[\left(2\sin\tfrac{\alpha - \beta}{2}\cos\tfrac{\alpha - \beta}{2}\right)\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
Kyun: Chaar factors ko aise jora ke har group mein ek hi angle ka "2 sin cos" ho. Phir \(2\sin u\cos u = \sin 2u\): aadhe angle ka double poora angle ban gaya.

Denominator
\[\sin\alpha\cos\alpha - \sin\beta\cos\beta\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}(\sin 2\alpha - \sin 2\beta)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot 2\cos(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= \cos(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
Kyun: \(\sin u\cos u = \frac{1}{2}\sin 2u\) (double-angle formula ka aadha). Phir \(\sin 2\alpha - \sin 2\beta\) par "sin − sin": aadha jama \(\frac{2\alpha + 2\beta}{2} = \alpha + \beta\), aadha farq \(\alpha - \beta\).

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)}{\cos(\alpha + \beta)\sin(\alpha - \beta)}\]
\[= \tan(\alpha + \beta) = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) upar neeche dono mein hai, cancel (zero nahi maan kar). \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\).

Tasdeeq: \(\alpha = 50^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 20^{\circ}\)
\[\text{L.H.S.} \approx \dfrac{0.5868 - 0.1170}{0.4924 - 0.3214} \approx 2.7475\]
\[\tan 70^{\circ} \approx 2.7475 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Calculator se dono taraf ek hi value aayi.
